title: 2025 AMC 12B Problem 23
statement: Let \(S\) be the set of all integers \(z \gt 1\) such that for all pairs of nonnegative integers \((x, y)\) with \(x \lt y \lt z,\) the remainder when \(2025x\) is divided by \(z\) is less than the remainder when \(2025y\) is divided by \(z.\) What is the sum of the elements of \(S?\)

solutions.text:
The condition requires \(k \mapsto 2025k \bmod z\) to be strictly increasing on \(\{0, 1, \ldots, z-1\}.\) A strictly increasing list of \(z\) distinct values in \([0, z-1]\) must be \(0, 1, \ldots, z-1,\) so \(2025 \equiv 1 \pmod z,\) i.e. \(2024\) is divisible by \(z.\) Since \(2024 = 2^3 \cdot 11 \cdot 23,\) the sum of all its divisors is \((1+2+4+8)(1+11)(1+23)\) \(= 15 \cdot 12 \cdot 24\) \(= 4320.\) Excluding \(z = 1\) leaves \(4319.\)

Thus, the correct answer is E.
hints: The condition says the map \(k \mapsto 2025k \bmod z\) is strictly increasing on \(0, 1, \ldots, z-1\)
An increasing rearrangement of \(0, 1, \ldots, z-1\) starting at \(0\) must be the identity, forcing \(2025 \equiv 1 \pmod z\)
